name: Friendships
overview: Scripture reveals that true friendships are marked by steadfast love, loyalty, and wisdom. A genuine friend shows compassion in times of affliction and remains faithful through adversity, as a brother is born for such moments. Walking with the wise leads to wisdom, while companionship with fools results in ruin. Moreover, love in friendship involves forgiveness and discretion, since exposing faults can divide even close friends, but a friend who sticks closer than a brother exemplifies the highest form of loyalty and kindness.
